messages:
lina: Heads-up 10: our webhook consumer started rejecting Stripe events overnight with signature verification errors. Finance reconciliation flagged 42 missing invoice posts.

mike: Error sample from logs:
```
WARN stripe_consumer: signature verification failed (sig_header=... v1 mismatch) event_id=evt_3Lxxxx
```

lina: Stripe rotated the signing secret for the endpoint without notifying us (we had a rotation window). Our consumer only had the old secret.

frank: That would cause webhook replays + missed events. Are customers charged?

lina: Charges succeeded on Stripe; only NetSuite import didn't get created for those webhook-triggered invoice postings.

ops-jen: @billing-bot open FIN-5201 and assign to eng+finance, mark P1 due to month-end reconciliation.

billing-bot: Created FIN-5201: "Webhook signature rotation: missed Stripe events -> backfill & failover" assigned to @mike, priority P1, link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-5201

mike: Immediate mitigation plan: (1) update consumer to accept both current and previous signing secret for 24h window, (2) add a health alert when many sig failures occur, (3) add a fallback that fetches event by id from Stripe API and verifies server-to-server if signature fails, then process. ETA for quick patch: 2hrs.

frank: For backfill: we should query Stripe for all events of type `invoice.payment_succeeded` between 2026-03-23T00:00Z and 2026-03-23T06:00Z where our system shows no NetSuite record. I'll script a dry-run list and produce `stripe_missed_invoices_2026-03-23.csv`.

lina: I've paused the automatic import retries to avoid duplicate postings once we replay.

ops-jen: SRE note: signature rotation should trigger a Slack notif if webhook secret changes in our secrets-manager. Let's add a lockstep runbook with on-call.

mike: Also adding audit write: save full Stripe event JSON to s3://redwood-billing/audit/stripe_events/{event_id}.json before any mutate, lifecycle 60d, ACL finance+eng. Will include original webhook header metadata in audit for forensic.

frank: Finance asks that the CSV include customer_id, invoice_id, stripe_event_id, amount, event_ts, and a suggested action (backfill/create/ignore).

mike: Will attach `stripe_missed_invoices_2026-03-23.csv` to FIN-5201 when dry-run complete. After review by finance we'll run the replay pipeline (idempotent).

billing-bot: FIN-5201 updated: comment from @mike with PR link https://git.redwood.ai/billing/commit/stripe-accept-previous-secret and scheduled backfill job.

lina: After patch, we'll run a controlled replay for the 42 events, confirm NetSuite post ids, then unpause retries. I'll post reconciliation csv and tag @maria-finance.

ops-jen: Also consider rotating signing secrets via deploy pipeline only and emit a change event to #sec-alerts.

mike: Agreed. Rolling patch now to staging; will post results in FIN-5201. ETA deploy to prod in next maintenance window if staging green.

lina: Thanks team. Finance, expect CSV and update in FIN-5201 shortly. :thumbsup:
